headline: Bessent Calls for External Nvidia CEO Search
deck: The Treasury secretary urged a shakeup as Nvidia’s board continues a search it says will consider internal and external candidates.
body: The change since the paper’s 13 November coverage is Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s public call for Nvidia’s board to focus on candidates outside the company for its next chief executive and for a dramatic shakeup [E4].

Bessent said chips above the H200 cannot be sold to China and said the more important question was whether Nvidia had a culture of compliance with U.S. export restrictions [E1]. He also asked whether Nvidia had used shell companies as a workaround to sell chips to China [E2].

Bessent said he wanted answers from Nvidia and its internal investigation within 10 days [E3]. Nvidia’s board had said on 12 November that it was initiating a search for a permanent chief executive and would consider internal and external candidates [E5].
